summary: Revise at 5.8, up from 5.4 (Caiman 7, ship bar 7.5, Corvus was cut at 6.6). Every recorded gate is now green. The round-1 gate failure is fixed: lands.ruby_collet_to_petal_mm reads 0.90 in both blocks. The export has 1,299,138 triangles, cold reload is identical, and the template gate passed with 1 design.set patch at 638,906 of 1,000,000 bytes. Art-wise, only two of the seven round-1 punch items are done. Done: (1) the land, and the collet foot now renders smooth with no saw-tooth; (3, part) the three cheek lancets now cut as clean, closed, pointed arches. Not done: (2) the eight spokes are still the same flat rectangular sticks (features 80-82) laid over the petal tracery. They stop short of the collet, run past the outer order with square butt ends, and float visibly above the openings (walls.png). The curved petal arcs under them still read as lotus or mandala. (3) The arcade still sits on a proud flat rectangular plate (features 19-22) glued onto the cheek, with bright flat sliver sills, and there is no arcade on the end walls. (4) The stacked shoulder discs are gone, which is good, but nothing replaced them. The shoulders and shank are now completely plain, so the doc's graded oculi are missing and the ring is even emptier off the face. (5) The table is still a lifted slab: side.png shows three stacked plates over the 001 head, which hides the factory wall-to-face angle and reads as stacked boxes (house rule 10). (6) The 16-cusp rim still does not render. (7) There is no medium or small scale anywhere off the face, which is far below Caiman's hero and the Reptilia sheet. Round 3 is the last. Getting from 5.8 to 7.5 takes the whole remaining list done in one round. The spokes, the slab, the plate and the off-face density are each worth roughly half a point. Anything short of that is a cut.
strengths: face-300 still reads as a rose window at a glance: a dark pierced wheel, a ruby at the hub, a raised outer order and trefoil corners.
The land is fixed and asserted at 0.90 mm. The collet foot renders as a clean, smooth ring (stones.png).
The cheek lancets are now three clean, closed, pointed openings with crisp outlines (walls.png, side.png), and the cutter bug from round 1 is gone.
Removing the proud stacked shoulder discs cleaned up the silhouette (shoulder.png).
The gate record is complete and green, and the export (1.3 M triangles) is now a real high-resolution build.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: The rose lives on the table alone. With the shoulder discs removed and nothing in their place, the shoulders and shank are blank. The cheek arcade is a small plate that looks stuck on, and the end walls are empty.

checklist.item: Reads as its Gothic subject at 300 px without the caption
checklist.reason: Narrowly, as in round 1. face-300 says rose window. The petal arcs and the floating spokes still pull toward 'mandala or ship's wheel medallion'. In hero-300 the cheek arcade is now faintly visible as three dark notches, but they do not yet read as lancets.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true, crisp outlines
checklist.reason: Marginal. The lancets, the pierced lights and the trefoils all render crisp, and the collet saw-tooth is gone. Against it: the bright flat sliver sills under the lancets read as artefacts, and the 16-cusp rim still does not render at all. The jagged highlight along the stock head seam (walls.png, end.png) needs watching.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, à jour, visible, coloured as stained glass
checklist.reason: One ruby in a drawn collet, ruby-tinted, with a through pilot. The collet foot is clean now. The collet is still a plain flat-topped tube with no moulding.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: Unchanged at its core. The spokes are flat bars with square ends floating over the tracery. The arcade sits on a flat rectangular plate. The table is a three-layer stacked slab (side.png). None of the tracery has a moulding or chamfer.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: The lifted, stacked table plates still overhang and step over the 001 head's face edge (side.png, end.png, walls.png).

checklist.item: Distinct silhouette; custom heads ≥ 13 mm; shoulder ornament not cut off before the face
checklist.reason: A 19 mm cushion with a round pierced rose is distinct within Tenebrae. There is now no shoulder ornament at all, so nothing is cut off, but that leaves a gap the density item counts against.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Worse than round 1 off the face. The only large form is the wheel, the only medium form is one small arcade plate per cheek, and there is no small scale at all. The shank, shoulders and end walls are plain.

punch_list.zone: Table: features 80-82 ('Spoke tops', 'Eight spokes along the mullions', 'Raise the spokes over the tracery') and the curved petal arcs in #6, r 2.75-7.2 (carried from R1 #2, not done)
punch_list.change: Delete features 80-82. Redraw the net in #3/#6 so each lancet's two sides are straight radial mullions 1.0 mm wide, running from the oculus order to the outer order and fused into both, with no gap and no overshoot. They curve only into each lancet's pointed head. Drop the continuous petal circles so no arc passes from one light into the next. Chamfer or round every bar top by 0.15-0.2 mm.
punch_list.acceptance: walls.png: no bar stands above the tracery plane with a visible gap or shadow beneath it, and no square butt end shows. stones.png: every mullion meets the collet's order and the outer order flush. face-300: eight straight gold mullions and eight pointed dark lancets, and no flower petals.

punch_list.zone: Table slab and the 001 head face edge, features 2-4 (the work plane and the 'Tracery top' stack) (carried from R1 #5, not done)
punch_list.change: Stop stacking plates. Put the work plane at the stock's own face, cut the rose down into the head (lights sunk ≥ 1.0 mm), and keep the tracery top flush with or ≤ 0.3 mm proud of the face and inset ≥ 0.5 mm from the face edge, so the factory wall-to-face angle survives unbroken all round.
punch_list.acceptance: side.png and end.png: one crisp factory edge between face and wall, and no visible stack of two or three plates above the head. walls.png: the head wall runs straight up to the face edge with no overhang.

punch_list.zone: Both cheeks, features 19-22 ('Gallery panel on a sill' and its mirror), plus both end walls at θ ≈ 90 ± 38 (carried from R1 #3, half done)
punch_list.change: Delete the proud panel plate. Cut the existing (now clean) three-lancet arcade directly into the stock cheek, 0.4-0.6 mm deep, and scale it up to fill ≥ 60% of the wall height. Replace the flat grey sliver sills with a 0.3 mm rounded sill moulding blended in at 0.1. Add the same arcade to both end walls with stamps ('Wall arcade'), as the doc specifies.
punch_list.acceptance: side.png, walls.png and end.png: three dark pointed lancets cut into the wall surface with no rectangular plate outline and no bright flat sill slivers. The end walls show the arcade. hero-300: the cheek arcade countable as three pointed lancets.

punch_list.zone: Shoulders, θ 90 − (44…74) and mirror (carried from R1 #4; the discs were removed but not replaced)
punch_list.change: Add the doc's graded oculi: 4 per side at 1.6, 1.4, 1.2 and 0.9 mm (round or quatrefoil), sunk ≥ 0.6 mm or pierced where lands allow. Frame each with a 0.3 mm roll moulding standing ≤ 0.2 mm proud, blended at 0.15. Nothing may stand past the shank silhouette.
punch_list.acceptance: shoulder.png and hero-300: four dark openings countable on the near shoulder, stepping smaller toward the palm. side.png: the shank outline is unbroken.

punch_list.zone: Shank from the shoulder oculi to θ 90 − 110 and mirror, plus the four corner trefoils (#90-92) (carried from R1 #7, not done)
punch_list.change: Add a small-scale band: a running cusped arcade or quatrefoil frieze, 0.2-0.3 mm relief, cut as true-outline stamps along both shank edges. Leave the palm plain. Dome or chamfer the trefoil bosses by 0.15 mm.
punch_list.acceptance: hero.png: large (rose), medium (arcades, oculi) and small (frieze, cusps) forms all visible, with no plain shank run above the palm longer than about 6 mm. The trefoils show a highlight gradient, not flat tops with vertical walls.

punch_list.zone: 16-cusp inner rim and the outer order, r ≈ 6.6-7.2 (carried from R1 #6, not done)
punch_list.change: Make the cusped rim render: 16 cusps ≥ 0.5 mm deep with dark behind them. Turn the outer order from a flat step into a half-round roll 0.6 mm wide standing 0.4 mm proud.
punch_list.acceptance: stones.png: 16 countable cusps and a rounded highlight on the outer order. face-300: a scalloped dark ring visible inside the outer order.

punch_list.zone: Oculus collet (#11-16) and the stock head-to-shoulder seam
punch_list.change: Give the collet a 0.15 mm chamfered or beaded top instead of a flat tube. Check the jagged highlight running along the head-to-shoulder seam (walls.png, end.png) and smooth it if it is a mesh artefact.
punch_list.acceptance: stones.png: the collet top shows a soft highlight edge. walls.png and end.png: the head seam highlight is a clean continuous line.
